caption.text:
60 SQL queries to crack any data interview 🧠

Sixty drills on PostgreSQL, built on one employees / departments / orders schema. They run from basics to the interview classics. Every task has a prompt, runnable solution code and the result on the sample data.

The families, in order:

1️⃣ The sample schema and data
2️⃣ Basics and filtering
3️⃣ Aggregates, GROUP BY and HAVING
4️⃣ Joins
5️⃣ Subqueries
6️⃣ Window functions
7️⃣ CTEs: basic, recursive and data-modifying
8️⃣ Real interview scenarios
9️⃣ Common mistakes and gotchas
🔟 A one-page SQL drills cheatsheet

Swipe through, write each query yourself first, then check it against the answer. Save this for your next interview prep session.

Comment “sql” to get every query and answer as a PDF.
